included.title: SEO audit findings you can act on
included.intro: The SEO audit is structured to support a decision, implementation, and a later check.

items.title: Findings
items.body: Observed technical, on-page, content, or local-search issues with the evidence behind them.

items.title: Prioritized fixes
items.body: Recommended actions ordered by relevance and dependency, not an unexplained score.

items.title: A 45-minute walkthrough
items.body: A scheduled call where we go through the first three findings together, what they cost you, and what you can safely leave alone.

items.title: Verification steps
items.body: Checks that show whether each implemented fix produced the intended change.

process.title: The SEO audit process: from context to plan
process.intro: The SEO audit process depends on the site and the access needed. Scope and expected delivery are confirmed before the review starts.

items.title: Share context
items.body: Send the website, the search problem you have noticed, and any market or platform constraints.

items.title: Review the SEO audit evidence
items.body: VANTFLOW examines the relevant site and search signals, separating observed issues from open questions.

items.title: Receive the action path
items.body: You receive findings, prioritized fixes, and verification steps for the work that follows.

items.title: Walk through it together
items.body: We spend 45 minutes on the first three findings: which one costs you the most, who can act on it, and what you can safely ignore. You get the call whether or not any further work happens.

fit.title: Useful when the next SEO decision is unclear
fit.body: The audit fits teams that need a bounded diagnosis before committing to implementation or ongoing support.
items: A site with visible search issues but no agreed priority
A planned redesign, migration, or content change that needs SEO review
An internal or agency team that needs an evidence-backed implementation brief

faq.title: Common questions about the SEO audit

items.question: What does the fixed price include?
items.answer: It includes documented findings, prioritised fixes, verification steps and a 45-minute walkthrough focused on the first three findings.

items.question: Do I need to buy further work?
items.answer: No. The report and walkthrough are complete deliverables. You can implement internally, seek another supplier or discuss a separate scope afterwards.

items.question: How long does the audit take?
items.answer: Timing depends on the site and access required. Scope and expected delivery are confirmed in writing before the review starts.

items.question: What should I send first?
items.answer: Send the website, the search problem you have noticed, the relevant market and any platform or access constraints.

next.title: Start with the site and the question
next.body: WhatsApp opens a prepared message. Add your website and relevant context; no account, form, or payment step is required.
next.credit: If you continue with a retainer scoped after the audit, the audit fee is credited to the first retainer month.
